added_words.description: Add these words to the spelling dictionary.

always_show_minimap_viewport.description: Keep the minimap's viewport indicator visible.

atomic_save.description: Write through a temporary file and rename it over the original. Even when true, files with hard links, another owner, or metadata that cannot be preserved are saved in place. In-place saves keep a rollback clone or a full staged revision for recovery.

auto_close_tags.description: Finish the innermost HTML or XML closing tag when a slash follows a less-than sign.

auto_complete_commit_on_tab.description: Commit the selected completion with Tab.

auto_complete_cycle.description: Cycle through the list when moving past either end.

auto_complete_delay.description: Delay before automatic suggestions appear, in milliseconds.

auto_complete_include_snippets_when_typi.description: Include snippet candidates in suggestions opened by typing.

auto_complete_preserve_order.description: Rank by match (none), match and likelihood (some), or source order (strict).

auto_complete_selector.description: Limit automatic suggestions to code and tags, excluding comments and multi-line strings.

auto_complete_size_limit.description: Largest buffer, in bytes, eligible for automatic completion.

auto_complete_trailing_spaces.description: Infer a space at the immediate end of line from repeated, mostly consistent occurrences.

auto_complete_trailing_symbols.description: Include punctuation inferred from other occurrences of a completed word.

auto_complete_triggers.description: Extra triggers accept a selector, optional characters and an optional rhs_empty flag.

auto_complete_use_history.description: Use prior completion choices when ordering candidates.

auto_complete_use_index.description: Include words from the project index.

auto_complete_when_likely.description: Offer suggestions when there is a likely match.

auto_complete_with_fields.description: Show automatic completions inside snippet fields.

auto_find_in_selection.description: Restrict searches or replacements to the current selection.

auto_indent.description: Enter keeps the indentation of the current line.

auto_match_enabled.description: Insert matching brackets and quotes while typing.

binary_file_patterns.description: Search omits these binary names while the sidebar continues to list them.

block_caret.description: Lane B round 18: display, tabs, window chrome and builds. Current reference: https://docs.sublimetext.io/reference/settings.html Detailed reference (same documentation project, archived): https://sublime-text-unofficial-documentation.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/settings.html Unspecified ST4 defaults retain Velocity's existing behavior. A filled insertion caret, independent of the blink style.

build_env.description: Environment defaults; per-build env and path take precedence.

caret_extra_bottom.description: Extend the caret below the line.

caret_extra_top.description: Extra caret height above and below the text line.

caret_extra_width.description: Add pixels to the caret width.

caret_style.description: Choose the insertion caret's shape or blink behavior.

close_deleted_files.description: Close clean views when their files are deleted.

close_find_after_find_all.description: Close Find after its Find All button runs.

close_find_after_replace_all.description: Close Replace after its Replace All button runs.

close_windows_when_empty.description: Close the window when its last document is closed.

color_scheme.description: Editor color scheme resource name, or auto to follow appearance.

copy_with_empty_selection.description: Copy and cut with no selection take the whole caret line.

dark_color_scheme.description: Color scheme used for dark appearance when the scheme is automatic.

dark_theme.description: Theme used for dark appearance when the theme is automatic.

default_completions_selector.description: Null uses the built-in scopes for HTML and CSS completions.

default_dir.description: Initial directory for Save As; empty uses the document directory or the system default.

default_line_ending.description: Line endings for newly created documents.

detect_indentation.description: Detects indentation on file open; an already open view keeps its detected or chosen indentation.

dictionary.description: Dictionary resource used for spell checking.

disable_default_completions.description: Suppress built-in HTML and CSS completions without hiding user snippets.

drag_text.description: Drag selected text with the mouse to move it; hold Option when releasing to copy.

draw_minimap_border.description: Draw a border around the minimap.

draw_white_space.description: Show spaces and tabs with visible marks. Use JSON to combine multiple modes.

enable_tab_scrolling.description: Scroll overflowing tabs; false fits all tabs into the strip.

ensure_newline_at_eof_on_save.description: Add a final newline when saving.

fade_fold_buttons.description: Reveal fold controls on hover instead of showing them constantly.

fallback_encoding.description: Used when decoding non-UTF-8 data on the next open or reopen.

file_exclude_patterns.description: File patterns omitted from the sidebar's file tree.

file_tab_style.description: Change the shape of document tabs.

find_selected_text.description: Seed Find, Replace and Incremental Find from a single-line selection.

fold_buttons.description: Show fold controls in the gutter.

folder_exclude_patterns.description: Folder patterns omitted from the sidebar's file tree.

font_size.description: Size of editor text in points.

git_diff_target.description: Choose the Git revision used for inline diffs.

goto_anything_exclude_gitignore.description: Filter the Goto Anything file list independently of symbol indexing and Find in Files.

hide_tab_scrolling_buttons.description: Hide the arrows for scrolling through tabs.

highlight_line.description: Highlight the line containing the caret.

highlight_line_number.description: Highlight caret-line numbers with the scheme's highlighted gutter color.

highlight_modified_tabs.description: Use the theme's dirty-tab label color.

hot_exit.description: Choose when to retain unsaved changes for the next session.

ignored_words.description: Do not flag these words as spelling errors.

image_file_patterns.description: Filename patterns shown in the image viewer.

indent_to_bracket.description: Lane A round 18: editing, find and completion preferences. Align a new line with the column just after an unmatched parenthesis or bracket.

index_exclude_gitignore.description: Respect Git ignore rules while indexing.

index_exclude_patterns.description: Patterns omitted from the symbol index.

index_files.description: Build a symbol index of project files.

index_include_patterns.description: Restrict symbol indexing to matching patterns when this list is nonempty.

index_skip_unknown_extensions.description: Skip files with no known syntax while indexing.

index_workers.description: Index worker count. Zero selects it automatically.

inverse_caret_state.description: Reverse the caret's visible blink phase.

large_file.diff_bytes.description: Size threshold for disabling inline diffs, in bytes.

large_file.indexing_bytes.description: Size threshold for skipping symbol indexing, in bytes.

large_file.load_bytes.description: File size at which to use the large-file loading path, in bytes.

large_file.long_line_bytes.description: Line length that activates large-file safeguards, in bytes.

large_file.max_line_bytes.description: Maximum bytes highlighted on a long line.

large_file.max_lookback_lines.description: Limit on lines scanned before the viewport.

large_file.max_viewport_lines.description: Limit on lines prepared for viewport highlighting.

large_file.minimap_lines.description: Line count threshold for disabling the minimap.

large_file.spell_bytes.description: Size threshold for disabling spell checking, in bytes.

large_file.viewport_bytes.description: File size at which highlighting is limited to the viewport, in bytes.

large_file.viewport_lines.description: Line count at which highlighting is limited to the viewport.

large_file.wrap_bytes.description: Size threshold for disabling automatic wrapping, in bytes.

light_color_scheme.description: Color scheme used for light appearance when the scheme is automatic.

light_theme.description: Theme used for light appearance when the theme is automatic.

line_numbers.description: Show line numbers next to the text.

line_padding_bottom.description: Add space below each line of editor text.

line_padding_top.description: Add space above each line of editor text.

margin.description: Set the horizontal inset for editor text.

match_brackets.description: Highlight the matching bracket at the caret.

match_brackets_content.description: Highlight brackets around the text between them.

match_selection.description: Highlight other occurrences of the selected word.

match_tags.description: Match opening and closing markup tags.

mini_diff.description: Show added, changed, and deleted lines in the gutter.

minimap_horizontal_scrolling.description: Scroll the minimap horizontally with the editor.

minimap_scroll_to_clicked_text.description: Keep clicked minimap text under the pointer instead of centering it.

mouse_wheel_switches_tabs.description: Use a vertical wheel over tabs to switch tabs instead of scrolling the strip. https://docs.sublimetext.io/reference/settings.html#global-settings

move_to_limit_on_up_down.description: Let Up and Down reach document limits from the first and last visual rows.

new_window_settings.description: File > New Window snapshots this dictionary over User preferences. An edit here only affects the next New Window. Launch, session restore and Settings do not use it.

open_files_in_new_window.description: File opens can target the current window, Finder/Dock only, or all sources.

overlay_scroll_bars.description: "system" follows macOS Show scroll bars; "enabled" overlays editor text and fades when idle, while "disabled" reserves space for an always-visible bar.

package_index_url.description: Explicit HTTPS index; no registry, timer or network request is enabled by default.

preview_on_click.description: Preview a sidebar file on one click; false selects it, and "only_left" restricts previews to left clicks.

regex_auto_escape.description: Escape selected buffer text when prefilling a regular-expression search.

relative_line_numbers.description: Number lines relative to the caret.

reload_file_on_change.description: Automatically reload clean files when they change on disk.

remember_open_files.description: Restore open files from the previous session.

result_base_dir.description: Base directory for relative build result paths.

result_file_regex.description: Match file locations in build output.

result_line_regex.description: Match line locations in build output.

ruler_style.description: Set the line pattern for rulers.

ruler_width.description: Set the stroke width of rulers.

rulers.description: Columns at which to draw rulers.

save_all_on_build.description: Save dirty named files before invoking a build.

save_on_focus_lost.description: Save changed files when their tab or window loses focus.

scroll_context_lines.description: Keep this many context lines near the caret when scrolling.

scroll_past_end.description: Allow scrolling beyond the last line. Edit a fractional distance in JSON.

scroll_speed.description: Keyboard scroll animation speed; zero jumps immediately. Pointer scrolling stays direct.

set_unsaved_view_name.description: Name untitled tabs from the first line of text.

shift_tab_unindent.description: shift+tab unindents everywhere instead of only in leading white space or across lines.

show_definitions.description: Show definitions or references when hovering over a symbol.

show_encoding.description: Show the document's encoding and line-ending format in the status bar.

show_errors_inline.description: Show build diagnostics next to the source line.

show_full_path.description: Include the full file path in the window title.

show_git_status.description: Show Git decorations in the sidebar.

show_git_status_in_status_bar.description: Show Git branch and status in the status bar.

show_line_column.description: "enabled" spells out the position; "compact" retains today's abbreviated item; "disabled" hides it.

show_line_endings.description: Show the document's line endings in the status bar.

show_minimap.description: Show a miniature overview of the document.

show_panel_on_build.description: Reveal output when a build starts.

show_rel_path.description: Include the project-relative path in the title.

show_side_bar.description: Show the sidebar with open files and folders.

show_status_bar.description: Show the status bar below the editor.

show_tab_close_buttons.description: Show a close button on each tab.

show_tab_close_buttons_on_left.description: Put the close button and dirty marker on the left when the button is enabled.

smart_indent.description: With auto_indent, the syntax's indentation rules add or remove a level.

spell_check.description: Check the spelling of text in supported scopes.

spelling_selector.description: Select the scopes where spell checking applies.

sub_word_separators.description: Treat these characters as additional boundaries for sub-word commands.

sublime_merge_path.description: Path to the Sublime Merge application.

tab_completion.description: Tab completes the word before the caret; false limits Tab to exact snippet triggers.

theme.description: UI theme resource name, or auto to follow appearance.

themed_title_bar.description: Apply the theme to the window title bar.

translate_tabs_to_spaces.description: Insert spaces instead of tab characters.

tree_animation_enabled.description: Animate folder rows unless Reduce Motion is enabled.

trim_automatic_white_space.description: Pressing Enter on a line that only holds indentation leaves it empty.

trim_only_modified_white_space.description: Trim whitespace only on lines changed since the last save.

ui_font_face.description: Empty uses the theme's UI font. A font family here overrides theme text only.

ui_font_size.description: Base font size for themed interface text.

ui_language.description: UI locale tag (for example en or zh-Hans), or auto (first supported macOS preferred language). Missing strings fall back through parent tags to English.

ui_scale.description: Scale the interface without changing the editor font.

update_system_recent_files.description: Add opened files to the macOS recent documents menu.

use_simple_full_screen.description: Use a simple full-screen window instead of a macOS Space.

use_tab_stops.description: With spaces, Tab and Backspace go to the next / previous tab stop.

vintage_ctrl_keys.description: Null uses the documented platform default (enabled on macOS). https://www.sublimetext.com/docs/vintage.html#ctrl-keys

vintage_start_in_command_mode.description: Start in command mode when a view enters Vintage.

vintage_use_clipboard.description: Use the system clipboard for Vintage registers.

word_separators.description: Characters that end a word for double click, word motions and super+d.

word_wrap.description: Wrap long lines at the configured width or the viewport.

wrap_width.description: Wrap at this column. Zero uses the available width.

wrap_width_style.description: Use a fixed wrap column even when it exceeds the viewport.
